name: SciTail: A Natural Language Inference Dataset from Science Exams
description: SciTail is a textual entailment / natural language inference benchmark created from multiple-choice school-level science exams and science texts found on the web. Consisting of 27,026 sentence pairs annotated as entails or neutral, it evaluates scientific reasoning and question-answering with natural sentence-level entailment.
